description.ja: 数学・STEM特化モデル。2024年7月16日公開。Project Numinaとの共同開発。Mistral 7Bベースの命令チューニング。複雑な多段階論理推論、数学的証明、科学計算に最適化。MATH 56.6%（単一）、68.37%（多数決）、74.59%（報酬モデル選択）達成。
description.en: Math and STEM specialized model. Released July 16, 2024. Co-developed with Project Numina. Instruction-tuned from Mistral 7B. Optimized for complex multi-step reasoning, mathematical proofs, and scientific computation. Achieves 56.6% (single), 68.37% (majority), 74.59% (PRM) on MATH.

specs.architecture: Dense Transformer, Instruction-tuned for math reasoning

description.en: Specialized for math/STEM reasoning. Achieves 56.6% on MATH.
